change.name: The Club SFO
change.location: Airside – after the main security checkpoint in Harvey Milk Terminal 1, keep left and follow the signs to B Gates. The Club is located on the right, just before Gate B4. The lounge can also be easily reached from International Terminal A, a short 5-minute walk, post-security.
restrictions: Access is permitted 2.5 hours prior to scheduled flight departure - Children under 2 years are admitted free - Children under 18 years must be accompanied by an adult - Alcoholic drinks are only available to passengers 21 years of age or older - Separate children's play area available - Quiet area.
Shower facilities are subject to payment (US$25 per person).

change.name: Golden Gate Lounge
restrictions: Maximum 3 hour stay - Children under 2 years are admitted free - Alcoholic drinks are only available to passengers 21 years of age or older.
No access will be given outside the published hours.

change.name: China Airlines Lounge
restrictions: Maximum 3 hour stay - Lounge access may be restricted due to lounge capacity constraints and the lounge reserves the right to reserve seating as necessary - Children under 2 years are admitted free.
No access will be given outside these hours.

change.name: Virgin Atlantic Clubhouse
change.location: Airside - Concourse A. After Security Checks, turn left and take the lift to Level 5.
restrictions: Access is permitted 3 hours prior to scheduled flight departure - All Cardholders are required to show a physical or digital card – All Cardholders and guests are required to show an SFO Outbound Departure Boarding Pass with confirmed same-day travel for access to the lounge - Children under 2 years are admitted free.

Maximum 3 hour stay - Cardholders will not be admitted into the lounge outside these hours - Lounge access may be restricted due to lounge capacity constraints and the lounge reserves the right to reserve seating as necessary.
Shower facilities are subject to payment (US$15 per shower).

change.name: Air India Maharajah Lounge
change.description: Air India Maharajah Lounge at SFO. Facilities include air conditioning, alcoholic drinks (standard), alcoholic drinks (premium-brand) — extra charge, cold buffet.
change.location: Airside - after security, Level 4, near Gate A1.
restrictions: Maximum 2 hour stay - Children under 2 years are admitted free.

ANC.name: Alaska Lounge — ANC
ANC.description: Expanded Alaska Lounge at Ted Stevens Anchorage International Airport in Concourse C near Gate C-1. The 140-seat lounge offers signature loungers with tarmac views, complimentary seasonal food and premium beverages, Kaladi Brothers espresso, West Coast wines, craft beers, custom cocktails, power outlets, Wi-Fi, and locally inspired Alaska art.
amenities: West Coast wine, craft beer and custom cocktails (21+)
restrictions: Access requires an eligible same-day boarding pass and a qualifying lounge membership, ticket/status benefit, or a paid single-entry pass when available.
Alaska Lounge members may bring immediate family or up to two guests, subject to eligibility and capacity.
Single-entry passes are sold only at participating lounges and when space is available; check current price and terms before travel.
An Alaska co-branded credit card alone does not provide complimentary lounge admission.

HNL.name: The Plumeria Lounge — HNL
HNL.description: Hawaiian Airlines' Plumeria Lounge is an Alaska Lounge member-access partner at Daniel K. Inouye International Airport. It is in Terminal 1 on the third floor. Alaska Lounge members and Lounge+ members may enter when departing HNL the same day on Alaska Airlines or Hawaiian Airlines. This is not an Alaska-branded lounge.
restrictions: Alaska Lounge or Lounge+ membership and same-day departure from HNL on Alaska Airlines or Hawaiian Airlines are required for the Alaska membership access benefit.
Eligible members may bring immediate family or up to two guests, subject to applicable access terms and capacity.
Alaska Summit Visa lounge day passes are not accepted at The Plumeria Lounge.
Current operating hours were not published in Alaska's lounge locator; confirm with the lounge or Hawaiian Airlines before travel.
